If the bowler tosses the ball over the Striker's head, or bowls it so wide that the Striker cannot play at it, the party that is in shall be allowed one notch, to be put down to them, and those balls not to be reckoned in any of the four balls. In the event of a change of bowling, not more than two balls to be allowed in practice.
